overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies Bhringraj Powder as a bulk botanical ingredient for B2B buyers. The product is processed from dehydrated Bhringraj leaves and offered with a fine 100 mesh profile for use in formulation work. We support OEM and private label requirements, along with custom mesh and packaging on request.

As an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, we serve buyers who need steady supply and export-ready handling. Our 6-step process covers sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. Minimum order quantity starts at 5 Kg, with samples available on request.

faqs.q: What is the MOQ for Bhringraj Powder?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 5 Kg.

faqs.q: Can you supply Bhringraj Powder for private label or OEM use?
faqs.a: Yes. We support OEM and private label supply for B2B buyers.

faqs.q: What mesh size and moisture level are available?
faqs.a: The standard product is offered at 100 mesh with moisture up to 8%.

faqs.q: What packaging options do you offer?
faqs.a: We offer 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5-10 kg bags, and small private-label pouches and jars.

faqs.q: Do you support export shipping documents?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide export documentation support for shipment handling.
